summary: Bilateral lungs, well aerated in the prior, become diffusely hazier with indistinct vessels on the current same-day follow-up, worse on the right.

findings.rationale: Matched via rib and hilar landmarks, both lungs are clear with sharp costophrenic angles in the prior; the same-day current study shows new diffuse haziness and loss of vascular clarity bilaterally, more pronounced on the right, consistent with rapidly developing edema rather than positioning change since patient rotation is similar.
